Currently only markPoint 'Target Range Low Hit' @idx15 marks the hit; no labelled TARGET level line exists. yAxis 87 = center of the Range Low zone (85-89); teal = target/with-the-move. The product principle requires the referenced 'target' to be drawn as a level, not only mentioned.

The quiz question explicitly names the midpoint — 'then immediately reverses and drops through the midpoint toward Range Low' — but the chart never draws it. This is neutral decision CONTEXT: it does not reveal the answer (the answer concerns stop-buffer placement, not the midpoint), so it is safe to show pre-cut. yAxis 91.5 between the Range Low (85-89) and Range High (94-98) zones, inside the ~83-102 band; gold per the chapter's midpoint convention.
